steps.text: Go down the ramp into the cellar south-west of Edron castle.
steps.source: Go down into the Edron Orc Cave. The entrance is southwest of the castle (Mapper Coords 129.149, 124.156, 7).

steps.text: Pull the lever if the stones block the way into the orc cave.
steps.source: You can access this area via a drain in the basement of the Edron Flats. (On the 7.1 map the cellar has a lever and stones that close the way.)

steps.text: Follow the cave west and south and drop down (orcs, orc spearmen, orc warriors, poison spiders).
steps.source: Once in the hole, you will meet only Orcs, Poison Spiders, Orc Spearmen and Orc Warriors. Follow the cave to the west and then south.

steps.text: Walk west to the three-way crossing, then all the way north and west to the room with the sacrificial stone at the far north-west end. Kill the orc shamans guarding it.
steps.source: After you drop down, follow the map below, by walking west to a three-way crossing. There, continue walking all the way north and then west. The reward is in a skeleton body in a room at the far north-western end of the floor, guarded by 2-3 Orc Shamans.

steps.text: The 3 blank runes are in the skeleton by the sacrificial stone (the skeleton isn't on the 7.1 map; this is its 7.6 spot).
steps.source: The reward is in a skeleton body in a room at the far north-western end of the floor. You can easily tell the right room, as it has a Sacrificial Stone in its center.
